jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description

Role: Data Analyst

We want you on our team!

Could you be our Data Analyst

Location: Houston Office // Remote // Flexible
Reporting To: Commercial Manager
Department/Team: Shipping Administration
Employment Type: Full-Time
Travel Requirements: None
Key Technologies/Tools: Microsoft 365 applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint, as well as GACagent and GACShip (training provided on the job).
Desk Job: Must be able to sit long periods of time at a computer.

What would your day at GAC look like?

Maintain, update, validate, and upload customer tariffs, supplier tariffs, port tariffs, and service rate structures within GACagent.
Perform customer and supplier master data maintenance, including Know Your Customer (KYC) updates, tariff calculations, periodic reviews, and data audits to ensure completeness, consistency, and compliance with company standards.
Investigate and resolve tariff-related discrepancies and coordinate with Operations, Commercial, and Finance teams to ensure data remains current, accurate, and reliable.
Gather, maintain, and organize data to support data management initiatives and business objectives.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure data is accurately collected, analysed, and maintained.
Troubleshoot data-related issues and implement solutions to improve data quality, integrity, and reliability.
Maintain customer master data and ensure billing instructions are accurately recorded and updated within GACagent.
Provide local system and process training to employees requiring additional support, ensuring effective utilization of GACagent and related data management processes.
Support continuous improvement efforts by identifying opportunities to enhance data management, tariff maintenance, reporting accuracy, and operational efficiency.

What’s in it for you?

This is your chance to become part of the global GAC team which has been providing professional shipping, logistics and marine services since 1956. Everything we do is guided by the GAC Spirit, built on mutual loyalty between management and staff, and a belief in the value of our people as individuals - not just for the jobs they do.

With more than 7,500 colleagues in 300 strategically located offices in more than 50 countries around the world, we focus on quality, safety and sustainability with a human touch. Emphasising a long-term approach, innovation and ethics, our flexible and integrated portfolios are designed to work within and support our customers’ operations.

Job Requirements

What are we looking for?

Bachelor’s degree in a related field (Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Business Administration, etc.) preferred.
Proficient computer skills, strong communication skills, strong understanding of Microsoft Office applications.
Customer and Supplier Tariff Administration, Commercial Data Management, Database Maintenance, Data Analysis, Data Reporting, Pricing and Rate Management,
Understanding of vessel agency charging structures, port tariffs, supplier costs, and customer pricing models preferred.

Soft Skills

Organizational Skills – Able to manage multiple tasks and requests simultaneously without losing track of deadlines or follow-ups.
Adaptability – Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment where priorities can shift with little notice.
Team Collaboration – Works effectively across GAC offices, agent networks, and internal teams, contributing to a culture of shared accountability and mutual support.
Communication Skills – Able to effectively and clearly communicate thoughts and ideas, using appropriate language and grammar.

Benefits

Medical PPO Plan Offered
Dental
Vision
401 (k) Match - up to 6 percent once eligible

Disclaimer

Please note that as well as working to recruit staff members via GAC channels, GAC does use third-party recruiters to recruit for specific positions within the Group. Please do however, be aware of unaffiliated recruiters purporting to represent GAC that ask for payment in return for facilitating interviews. A genuine third-party recruiter working with GAC will never ask for payment to facilitate an interview. If you would like to make an application to join GAC, please always ensure to apply through our official channels on https://career.gac.com/

Not Applicable

Employment type

Industries

jobs.title: Program Coordinator/Systems Integrator
jobs.description:
Job ID: 2617570

Location:
Chantilly, VA, US

Date Posted:
2026-10-04

Category:
Engineering and Sciences

Subcategory:
Systems Engineer

Schedule:
Full-Time

Shift:
Day Job

Travel:
No

Minimum Clearance Required:
TS.SCI_wPoly

Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain:
None

Potential for Remote Work:
ORA_ON_SITE

Description

SAIC has an immediate opening on an exciting mission focused program in Chantilly. We are seeking a driven candidate to support a variety of activities directly related to engagement with internal and external partners. Day-to-day support will revolve around helping the customer with the nuanced details of coordinating and facilitating the successful accomplishment of operational support related to external partner engagement. You will be aligned to an operational element of the customer organization, but will also coordinate with other customer and contractor personnel supporting this broader activity.

Qualifications

Must currently hold a TS/SCI and Poly in order to be considered
Project Management Professional certification (PMP) is required
Minimum of 9 years of relevant experience
Bachelor's Degree or relevant experience can be substituted for the degree
Experience managing technical projects with the ability to drive progress toward deliveries and due dates, manage dependencies between efforts, and communicate with stakeholders
Demonstrated experience in end-to-end planning and documentation, optimization, change, and risk management
Demonstrated experience and deep knowledge of the customer's internal and external communication and deconfliction processes and methods to manage internal and external communications
Apply exceptional interpersonal skills and experience using customer processes to enhance and drive external partner engagement, achieve specific objectives for customer priorities, and translate external perspectives and organizational dynamics to the customer
Ability to work independently to respond in a timely manner to field elements, obtain answers to questions, complete write-ups of meetings with external partners, and ensure that critical parts of meetings are captured in official communications
Ability to ensure plans are communicated to all stakeholders, prompt responses to mission elements and internal management are given, responses that need input from others are tracked, and inputs or responses to questions are proactively completed
While the position doesn't require hands-on technical knowledge, the candidate must have the ability acquire a level of familiarity with the customer's technology, as it is necessary to be conversant on the customer's projects and to have context important to stakeholder engagement
Must have exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to "get things to done"
Must have the mentality that no job is beneath you. This is a highly dynamic and streamlined team and everyone must pitch in wherever needed, even if that doesn't directly relate to the primary job functions

Target salary range: $160,001 - $200,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Not Applicable

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Defense and Space Manufacturing
